headline: Dividend Stocks Rally in October as Tech Sector Struggles
summary: ETFs focused on dividend-paying stocks are seeing a powerful rally in October, adding to strong gains for the year as technology shares face headwinds.
why: Investors often rotate out of volatile growth and technology equities into cash-generating dividend stocks during periods of market uncertainty.

impacts.name: Dividend Equities
impacts.why: Capital rotation away from struggling technology shares drives demand and price gains for high-yielding dividend ETFs.

why_moved: A sector rotation from technology stocks into defensive, income-generating equities drove heavy inflows into dividend-focused exchange-traded funds.
